simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to צַאֲנָן (H6630) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: צַאֲנָן (Tsaʼănân) means Zaanan , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Mic 1 11.

definitions.full: H6630. Tsaanan צַאֲנָן proper name, of a location Micah 1:11 Σεννααρ [ ν ], perhaps = צְנָן in the Shephelah of Judah Josh 15:37 , Σεννα ( μ ). [ צֶאֱצָא ] see יצא . I, II. צָב see I, II. צבב .
definitions.rootNote: from the same as 6629 used denominatively; sheep pasture ;
